description: Source code for network interface statistics monitoring, including functions to parse Linux system stats, update radio, access point, and endpoint statistics, and handle VLAN interfaces.

methods.name: s_addRadioStats
methods.description: Adds radio interface statistics from source to destination stats structure.

methods.name: s_addTxRxStats2Stats
methods.description: Aggregates interface statistics into a stats structure, updating the latest update time.

methods.name: s_getLinuxLineStats
methods.description: Parses a line of Linux interface stats and updates corresponding radio, WDS, VLAN, or endpoint stats.

methods.name: s_getLinuxStats
methods.description: Reads Linux system network stats from a file and updates radio and SSID stats.
